run_eval_vqa: run the VQA evaluation script with pretrained model weights and test split
evaluate_model: evaluate a MultiModalBertForVQA model on a VQA dataset split and save results as JSON
compute_score_with_logits: compute VQA evaluation scores from model logits and ground truth labels
create_vqa_dataset: create a VQAClassificationDataset from image features, tokenizer, and a data split
build_vqa_dataloader: build a DataLoader for VQA evaluation with batched image features and question inputs
